about_insurance_body: Dufite ibyo buri ivuriro rivuga ko ryemera. Ntitubona ubwishingizi bwawe, bityo ntitwakubwira ko wowe ubwawe wishyuriwe — banza ubaze ku ivuriro mbere yo kubyiringira.
about_insurance_title: Icyo twabwira ku bwishingizi n'icyo tutabasha
about_lede: MediLink igufasha gushaka ubuvuzi mu Rwanda no kumenya icyo witega mbere yo kugenda.
about_privacy_body: Nomero ya telefoni ni yo MediLink ikumenyeraho kandi ni yo ivuriro rigukoresha iyo igihe cyawe kigeze. Ushobora gukuramo ibyo dufite byose, cyangwa ukabisiba, uhereye kuri konti yawe.
about_verified_body: Ivuriro ryemejwe ni iryo umukozi wa MediLink yagenzuye ko ribaho, riri aho bivugwa, kandi ritanga serivisi zavuzwe. Si amanota, si icyemezo cy'ubuziranenge bw'ubuvuzi. Ntiduha amanota amavuriro cyangwa abaganga.
about_wait_body: Kiva ku ivuriro ubwaryo, kandi ari uko ryanditse abantu bahagije kugira ngo umubare ube ufite icyo uvuze. Iyo ari bake cyane, cyangwa ivuriro ritatwoherereza umurongo, tuvuga ko igihe kitaboneka. Ntitwigera tugikeka.
about_what_body: Ikwereka amavuriro yemejwe ari hafi yawe, ubwishingizi buri rimwe rivuga ko ryemera, igihe bafite gahunda zidafite abantu, kandi — iyo ivuriro ryotwoherereza umurongo — igihe abantu bamaze bategereje.
appointment_arrival_note: Uzabona ubutumwa bwo kukwibutsa mbere y'igihe.
appointments_no_slots: Nta gahunda ihari mu byumweru bibiri biri imbere.
appointments_none_bookable: Iri vuriro ntiryakira gahunda kuri MediLink. Ushobora kujyayo cyangwa ugahamagara mbere.
auth_bad_credentials: Izina cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga si byo.
auth_code_sent_to: Twoherereje kode y'imibare 6 kuri SMS kuri
auth_consent: Nemeye ko MediLink ibika amakuru yanjye y'ubuvuzi nk'uko bisobanurwa muri
auth_no_surface: Iyi konti ntaho ihuriye n'ubu buryo. Vugana na MediLink.
auth_phone_hint: Ni ho tuzakumenyesha igihe cyawe kigeze.
auth_privacy_note: Amakuru yawe ni ayawe. Ushobora kuyasohora cyangwa kuyasiba igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
auth_prompt: Injira kugira ngo utegure kandi ukurikirane umurongo
auth_staff_note: Abakozi b'amavuriro bahabwa konti na MediLink - ntibiyandikisha.
auth_too_many: Wagerageje kenshi cyane. Tegereza umunota umwe.
auth_wrong_surface_body: Winjiye, ariko iyi konti ntabwo ifite uburenganzira kuri iki gice.
book_no_slots: Nta masaha aboneka muri iki gihe.
booking_insurance_note: MediLink imenya ko ivuriro ryemera ubu bwishingizi, ariko ntisuzuma ko ubwawe bukora.
cancel_note: Guhagarika bituma undi muntu abona umwanya.
care_guide_body: Tubwire ibyo urimo kumva, tukwereke ubwoko bw'ubuvuzi bukwiye n'amavuriro abutanga.
care_guide_disclaimer: Ibi si ubuvuzi. Niba bikomeye, jya kwa muganga ako kanya.
care_guide_emergency_first: Niba bikomeye cyane, ntugategereza ibi bibazo. Jya kwa muganga ako kanya.
care_guide_incomplete: Ibi bibazo ntibyarangiye neza. Shakisha ikigo cy'ubuvuzi.
care_guide_intro: Ibibazo bike bikwereka serivisi ikwiye. Ntabwo ari ubuvuzi.
care_guide_no_recommendation: Nta serivisi yihariye twabashije kukwereka. Sura ikigo cy'ubuvuzi kikwegereye.
care_guide_point_1: Kikubaza ibibazo bike ku byo wumva.
care_guide_point_2: Kikwereka serivisi yo gusura - si indwara ufite.
care_guide_privacy: Ibisubizo byawe ntibibikwa. Iyo urangije birasibwa.
care_guide_result_body: Iyi ni inama yo kukwereka aho wagana. Muganga ni we ugusuzuma.
care_guide_symptom_hint: Sobanura mu magambo yawe, cyangwa usimbuke usubize ibibazo.
care_guide_symptom_privacy: Bikoreshwa gusa mu guhitamo aho gutangirira. Ntibibikwa.
care_guide_unavailable: Inama ku buvuzi ntiraboneka. Igitegereje kwemezwa na muganga.
care_guide_unavailable_body: Ushobora gushakisha ibigo n'abaganga muri iki gihe.
compare_empty_body: Hitamo amavuriro abiri cyangwa atatu kugira ngo uyagereranye.
compare_partial: Ibigo {n} ntibyashoboye kuzana amakuru. Ibindi birerekanwa.
doctor_unverified_note: Uyu muganga ntarasuzumwa na MediLink. Banza ubaze ivuriro.
doctors_body: Shakisha umuganga ukurikije ubuhanga, ururimi cyangwa izina.
doctors_verification_note: Abaganga banditse hano batangwa n'amavuriro. Reba ko byemejwe.
emergency_disclaimer: Aya ni amavuriro yatubwiye ko afite serivisi y'ibyihutirwa. Niba bikomeye, hamagara {number} mbere yo kugenda.
emergency_none: Ntitwabashije kubona ivuriro rifite serivisi y'ibyihutirwa hafi yawe. Hamagara {number}.
error_screen_body: Nta cyo wakoze nabi, kandi nta cyo wabitse cyabuze. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa usubire ku ntangiriro.
error_screen_title: Hari ikitagenze neza kuri iyi paji
footer_not_medical_advice: MediLink igufasha gushaka no kugera ku buvuzi. Ntisuzuma indwara, kandi ntitanga inama z'ubuvuzi.
footer_tagline: Shakisha amavuriro yemejwe hafi yawe, urebe ko yemera ubwishingizi bwawe, kandi umenye igihe cyo gutegereza mbere yo kugenda.
help_book_body: Fungura ivuriro, uhitemo serivisi, uhitemo isaha. Ugomba kuba winjiye, bisaba nomero ya telefoni na kode tukoherereza kuri SMS. Nimero ya gahunda yawe iri ku ipaji ya gahunda.
help_contact_body: Baza ku biro by'ivuriro iryo ari ryo ryose rikoresha MediLink — barebera gahunda yawe n'umwanya wawe ku murongo.
help_data_body: Konti yawe ifite byombi. Gusiba bikuraho izina, nomero na aho uba mu byo dufite; ivuriro rigumana imibare yaryo, nta kintu kikwerekana.
help_emergency_body: Ntukoreshe MediLink mu gufata icyemezo. Hamagara {number} cyangwa ujye ku ivuriro rya hafi ubu.
help_queue_body: Iyo ivuriro rikwandika ku biro byaryo, umwanya wawe ugaragara munsi ya Ingendo. Iyo ivuriro ryanditse abantu bahagije, tunakubwira igihe cyo kugenda — kandi iyo tutabizi ntituvuga, aho kugikeka.
help_turned_away_body: Amakuru y'ubwishingizi ava ku ivuriro, ashobora kuba ashaje. Bwira ivuriro kugira ngo rikosore, kandi utubwire natwe tubikurikirane.
hero_body: Shakisha amavuriro, abaganga na serivisi hafi yawe. Menya mbere yo kugenda.
insurance_accepts_note: Tuvuga icyo ivuriro ryemera, ntitubwira ko wishyuriwe. Emeza ku ivuriro.
insurance_disclaimer: Ibi ni ibyo buri ivuriro rivuga ko ryemera. Si icyemezo ko ubwishingizi bwawe bukora — banza ubaze ivuriro mbere yo kugenda.
insurance_intro: Hitamo ubwishingizi bwawe urebe amavuriro ari hafi yawe abwemera, n'ibyo buri rimwe ryishyura.
insurance_none_nearby: Nta ivuriro riri hafi yawe ryatubwiye ko ryemera {insurer}. Gerageza akandi karere, cyangwa ubaze ivuriro.
insurance_pick_body: Hitamo bumwe hejuru, tukwereke amavuriro ari hafi yawe abwemera.
leave_by_needs_home: Shyiraho aho utuye kugira ngo tukubwire igihe cyo kugenda.
leave_by_no_estimate: Iri vuriro ntirifite amakuru ahagije yo kubara igihe.
map_needs_results: Nta vuriro ryo kwerekana ku ikarita.
nearby_needs_a_place_body: Hitamo akarere kawe hejuru, tukwereke amavuriro akinguye hafi yawe.
no_active_queue_body: Uzagaragara hano nyuma yo kwiyandikisha ku ivuriro.
no_messages_body: Uzabona ubutumwa igihe utegereje cyangwa ufite gahunda.
no_slots_body: Gerageza indi serivisi cyangwa irindi vuriro.
no_slots_provider_body: Uyu muganga nta masaha afite. Gerageza uwo ari we wese.
onb1_body: Shakisha amavuriro ya Leta n'ayigenga, urebe ubwishingizi bwemewe, kandi umenye ko hari umwanya - mbere yo kuva mu rugo.
onb2_body: Fata igihe cyo kwivuza, hanyuma ukurikirane aho ugeze ku murongo uri mu rugo. Tukubwira igihe cyo kugenda iyo tubizi.
onb3_body: Tubwire ibyo wumva, tukwereke serivisi ikwiye. Ni inama, si ubuvuzi.
out_of_bounds: Aho uri ntibigaragara ko ari mu Rwanda
preferences_note: Kode zo kwinjira n'ubutumwa bwo guhagarika gahunda buhora bwoherezwa.
privacy_contact_body: Aderesi yo kubaza ku makuru yawe izashyirwaho mbere y'uko MediLink itangira gukoreshwa.
privacy_draft_warning: Iyi ni inyandiko y'agateganyo. Ntiragenzurwa n'umunyamategeko, bityo igomba kubanza kugenzurwa mbere y'uko MediLink ikoreshwa mu buryo bwuzuye.
privacy_rights_body: Ushobora gusohora amakuru yawe yose, cyangwa kuyasiba, igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Iyo uyasibye, amavuriro abika imibare gusa - ntawe ukimenya ko ari wowe.
privacy_triage_body: Ibyo usubiza mu nama ku buvuzi ntibibikwa. Icyo tubika ni umubare gusa - serivisi yagusabwe - kandi ntigipfundikanye na wowe.
privacy_what_insurer: Ubwishingizi wahisemo, kugira ngo tukwereke amavuriro abwemera.
privacy_what_location: Aho utuye, iyo wabyemeye - kugira ngo tukubwire igihe cyo kuvamo.
privacy_what_not: Ntabwo tubika ibisubizo by'ibizamini, ubuvuzi wahawe, cyangwa amakuru y'ubwishyu.
privacy_what_phone: Nomero ya telefoni yawe. Ni yo iranga konti yawe.
privacy_what_visits: Ibisura byawe: aho wagiye, ryari, na serivisi.
privacy_who_audit: Buri gihe umuntu areba dosiye yawe, birandikwa: uwo ari we, ryari, n'icyo yarebye.
privacy_who_body: Abakozi b'ivuriro babona gusa abarwayi baje kwa bo. Ntibabona abandi.
profile_home_why: Bidufasha kukubwira igihe cyo kugenda. Ni ubushake.
queue_explainer: Igihe cyo gutegereza kiva ku ivuriro ubwaryo, kandi ari uko ryanditse abantu bahagije. Iyo tutabizi, turabikubwira aho kugikeka.
queue_load_failed: Ntibyakunze kureba aho ugeze mu murongo.
queue_load_failed_body: Ibi ntibisobanura ko wavuye mu murongo. Ongera ugerageze.
queue_not_reporting: Iri vuriro ntiritwoherereza amakuru y'umurongo, bityo ntitwabwira igihe cyo gutegereza.
queue_set_home: Shyiraho aho utuye kugira ngo tukubwire igihe cyo kugenda
radius_expanded: Nta vuriro riri muri km {original}. Turerekana iri muri km {actual}.
searching_district: Amavuriro yo mu karere ka {district}. Nta ntera ivuzwe kuko tutamenya aho uri.
service_insurance_note: Ubwishingizi butandukana ku ivuriro. Reba ku rupapuro rw'ivuriro.
services_intro: Reba ibyo amavuriro ari hafi yawe atanga, ubone aho ubona icyo ukeneye.
sign_in_to_book_body: Gushakisha ntibisaba kwinjira, ariko gutegura birabisaba.
sign_in_to_track: Banza winjire kugira ngo urebe umurongo
sms_note: Ubu butumwa bwoherezwa kuri SMS, ntibusaba interineti.
splash_sub: Shakisha, ufate igihe, ukurikirane - mu minota mike.
ussd_hint: Nta telefoni igezweho? Kanda {code} kuri telefoni iyo ari yo yose
value_insurance_body: Reba ivuriro ryemera ubwishingizi bwawe mbere yo kugenda.
visits_none_body: Iyo ufashe igihe cyo kwa muganga, kizagaragara hano.
wait_unavailable_explained: Amakuru y'umurongo ntaboneka kuri iki kigo.
wait_unavailable_list: Ibi bigo ntibiratangaza igihe cyo gutegereza.
